# Withholding: Get Austria KESt withholding for an account

Area overview and notes: [withholding.md](../withholding.md)

`GET /withholding/austria` · tenant-scoped token

Retrieve an account's year-to-date Austria KESt (27.5%) withholding balance in EUR, optionally with the contribution of a single transaction. The account must use the austria disposition method.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tax_year` | integer | No | Calendar year (Europe/Vienna) to scope the summary to. Defaults to the transaction year when transaction_id is supplied, otherwise the current year. |
| `transaction_id` | string | No | Your system's unique identifier for a transaction. When supplied, the response includes that transaction's attribution and the summary is scoped to its tax year. |
| `account_id` | string | No | Your system's unique identifier for the account. Required unless x-user-id is supplied. |

**Response 200**: Austria withholding summary

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `summary` | object | Yes |  |
| `summary.year_to_date_balance` | string | Yes | EUR KESt (27.5%) withholding balance for the tax year to date, after loss compensation. |
| `summary.latest_transaction_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | Datetime of the latest transaction included in the balance. Null when no Austria calculation has run. Nullable. |
| `transaction` | object | Yes | Per-transaction attribution for the requested transaction_id. Null when transaction_id was not supplied or has not been calculated yet. Nullable. |
| `transaction.change_in_balance` | string | Yes | Signed EUR contribution of this transaction to the year-to-date withholding balance. |
| `transaction.transaction_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes |  |
| `transaction.transaction_id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the transaction. Nullable. |
| `tax_year` | integer | Yes | Calendar year (Europe/Vienna) the summary is scoped to. |
| `fiat_asset` | object | Yes | Fiat asset the balance is denominated in. Null when no Austria calculation has run. Nullable. |
| `fiat_asset.code` | string | Yes | Asset code. |
| `fiat_asset.name` | string | No |  |
| `fiat_asset.symbol` | string | No |  |
| `fiat_asset.type` | string | Yes | Asset type. |
| `fiat_asset.uuid` | string (uuid) | No | Asset UUID in the Taxbit system. |

**Errors:** 401 Unauthorized · 409 The account does not use the austria disposition method, or tax_year does not match the year of transaction_id · 429 Too Many Requests
